items.title: Why Is Dominion Energy (D) Facing Tough Questions In Virginia Merger Hearings?
items.summary: Dominion Energy (NYSE:D) is facing formal Virginia State Corporation Commission hearings on its proposed merger with NextEra Energy. The Virginia proceeding focuses on the proposed US$67b transaction and its potential effects on state energy pricing and reliability. Public comments from citizens, local governments, and advocacy organizations have been entered into the record ahead of this week's evidentiary sessions. items.title: DOJ closes antitrust probe into NextEra’s $66.8 bln Dominion deal
items.summary: Investing.com-- The U.S. Department of Justice said on Thursday it had closed its antitrust investigation into Nextera Energy's (NYSE:NEE) $66.8 billion acquisition of Dominion Energy (NYSE:D) after the companies committed to safeguards addressing concerns over electricity prices in New England.
